values.note: 2026: water + electric site $30 Mon-Thu, $35 Fri-Sun, $40 holiday; full hookup $35 / $40 / $45; monthly $600 / $675; seasonal $1,600 / $1,900 (the booking site quotes the same nightly figures for July 2027). $5 non-refundable processing fee per site reserved. A Mecosta County Parks vehicle permit ($7 a day; annual permit for all county parks $35) is required on top of camping fees; the Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid. No resident/non-resident price difference.

values.note: 66 campsites (46 standard water + electric, 20 full hookup) plus two group sites and three cabins. All back-in; site depths 27-64 ft on the booking site, which offers trailers/RVs up to 50 ft (over 50 ft at some standard sites). Any site may also be rented seasonally.

values.note: Reserve online (an account is needed to check out); 2-night minimum on all campsite reservations, 3 nights on holiday and event weekends. Payment in full when booking.

'There is a 2-night minimum stay for all campsite/cabin reservations with a 3-night minimum during holiday or event weekends.' 'Payments must be made in full at the time of placing reservations.'; 'Click Here To Reserve Online' -> https://mecostacounty.goingtocamp.com/), read 2026-10-25

note: Mecosta County park on the Muskegon River at the old Paris fish hatchery (1881-1964; hatchery building with a pictorial history, trout ponds), north of Big Rapids beside the White Pine Trail. Canoe/kayak/tube launch; the park runs tube rentals and shuttles upriver Thursday-Sunday in season. --Claude
